title: The one-page CV: what to cut, and what to prove

videos.script: The first person to read your CV will spend about ten seconds on it. Not because they are careless: there are two hundred more behind it. {{ten}} In those ten seconds they are looking for two things. What you do, and whether you have done it. {{two}} Most first CVs hide both. They open with a photo, an age and an objective about growing in a dynamic company, and the project that proves something is on page three. {{hide}} This lesson cuts a real first CV down to one page. What goes, what stays, and how the proof that you can do the job moves to where the ten seconds land.
